adopted_from.note: decision, operators and thresholds were frozen in W27 before any number was seen; this task re-uses them verbatim (no threshold moved after the W27 result was known) and extends the deviation table from a single anchor point to all 6

prereg.decision: May the archived SUBOFF three-tier LBM ladder be certified against the DTRC AFF-1 tow-tank anchor at the anchor Reynolds number, and may the anchor itself be cited as a published experimental benchmark in this environment?
alternatives: H1: ladder is in the asymptotic range (p >= 1.8, GCI_fine < 5%) and the same-Re transposed Cd matches anchor C_T within 15% under OP1 and OP2 alike -> ladder and anchor are both usable for a resistance claim
H2: ladder is pre-asymptotic (p < 1.8 or GCI_fine >= 5%) -> no converged C_T exists at these resolutions and no drag-agreement claim may be certified
H0: the Re transposition is ill-conditioned (OP1 vs OP2 spread > 15 pp) -> the comparison tests the transposition assumption, not the solver
H3 (grading): the anchor is a second-hand transcription -> it stays grade C until the primary reports are acquired, whatever the numbers say

metrics.gci_fine_pct: Roache GCI of the finest tier, Fs = 1.25, true unequal refinement ratios
metrics.p_observed: observed order of accuracy from the three grids
metrics.rel_dev_pct: 100*(Cd_transposed/C_T_anchor - 1) per tier and per anchor point

baseline_control: operator-layer control: the ITTC-1957 line itself plus two in-repo round-off known answers (Cf(1.2e7) = 0.00291, Cf(2.0e6) = 0.00405, declared +/-5%)
geometric control: Cb / L-over-D / analytic wetted area re-verified before any drag comparison
arithmetic control: libm double vs Decimal-50 as two disjoint evaluation paths
ladder control: three arms reported (E2 standard, archived mix50, bare-hull) - the geometry-matched arm is disclosed next to the arm the mission names
prereg.stopping_rule: no threshold may be relaxed after the numbers are seen; a criterion that fails is registered as honest FAIL and stays in the artifact (append-only)
prereg.unit_of_analysis: one archived tier (grid) x one anchor point of one archived ladder arm

controlled: archived run protocol (code, collision model, n_steps per tier, seeds)
Re convention (L_max, nu = 1.139e-6 m2/s) and C_T definition
changed: Re of comparison (case Re = 1e3 vs anchor Re 1.16e7..3.54e7, through the operators)

confounders: four-decade Reynolds gap between case (1e3) and anchor (1.16e7..3.54e7)
the with-sail ladders model AFF-3 geometry while the anchor is the AFF-1 bare hull (a geometry-matched bare-hull arm is disclosed alongside)
the ladder normalises drag with the legacy cylinder proxy pi*D*L (+19% area vs the analytic wetted area) while the anchor uses WSA = 5.998 m2 (handled explicitly in OP2)
an instrument change inside the case (erratum E2 swapped mix50 -> standard), so arms A and B are not replicates of each other
n_steps differ per tier (14400/16800/19200): the window is the same 1000-step average but the statistical residual differs per tier
prereg.repetition_rationale: the ladders are already-archived deterministic LBM runs; the three-grid triple is the replication unit for discretisation error and every branch of the triple is read from a frozen archive with a registered sha256. No new run is submitted: benchmarks/verified/suboff_sail_resistance/gci_v4.json recorded 15-20 s/step at L=96 on this host, i.e. 61-144 h per tier at the anchor Re, so a new anchor-Re ladder is out of budget for this task; that gap is disclosed, not hidden
prereg.environment: CPU-only loongarch64 container; the archived ladders were produced earlier on cuda:6 and are read-only inputs here
prereg.analysis: per tier: GCI/p from the three-grid triple with asymmetric ratios; then the per-tier transposed value at each of the 6 anchor Re and its deviation; the aggregate is the table itself, not a mean (each tier is a different discretisation of the same continuum problem)
prereg.safety_resource_limits: read-only analysis of in-repo archives, no cluster jobs submitted (budget 100 calls / 14400 s untouched)
interpretation_limits: an OP1-within-15% result is not a solver validation: OP0 (identity) sits 4 decades away and OP2 disagrees by hundreds of percent, so agreement is decided by the transposition assumption
single-case ensemble: three grids of one case at one Reynolds number; no multi-Re or multi-hull sweep is added here
the anchor is second-hand (grade C): even a perfect agreement would only mean 'agrees with a transcription of Table 14'

landing.why_recovered: W27 registered the anchor on the mission branch only; the branch was never merged, so W28's anchor gate read the main worktree and raised NO-ANCHOR-ARTIFACT
landing.regeneration_note: re-running benchmarks/anchors/lbm_suboff_tau_anchor.py (without --check) rebuilds the file from the archives and drops the gate-v3 grading block; re-apply it with papers/artifacts/w28/lbm-suboff-tau/build_anchor_landing.py. The guard test test_strip_recovers_the_branch_blob_byte_for_byte fails if the block disappears.
